objective: Phase 3 HTTP Reader Mode & Raw Mode Webview

tech_stack.app: Rust + relm4 + gtk4 (native shell, NOT webview-based except raw-mode tabs)
tech_stack.http: reqwest (0.13 - per-request redirect removed; Client-level redirect policy only)
tech_stack.html_readability: legible crate (Rust Readability.js port); scraper/html5ever; comrak for markdown; feed-rs for feeds (Phase 1.1)
tech_stack.adblock: Brave adblock crate (EasyList+EasyPrivacy bundled at build time)
tech_stack.webview: platform native: macOS WKWebView (objc2-web-kit), Linux webkit6, Windows webview2-com — ONLY raw-mode tabs (ADR 0002)

architecture_snapshot.http_adapter: 3.7 adds HttpAdapter to hypernext-protocol dispatcher as the prefix-less http/https default (handoff h1); WebFinger keeps https only for it/.well-known/webfinger via path sub-routing (longest-prefix-wins)
architecture_snapshot.raw_vs_reader: Dispatcher::fetch resolves WebMode per origin; Reader -> fetch_and_extract -> PageDoc; Raw -> Block::Raw { mime: application/x-webview } placeholder that the UI renders via RawWebView, not ReaderView
architecture_snapshot.reader_render: hypernext-ui reader_view.render_page_doc(doc) calls Phase 2 document_view::render_blocks + metadata header + featured-image dedup

high_risk.macos_webview_spike: WKWebView does NOT natively integrate with GTK4. SPIKE in p3-t4 MUST pick: (a) GtkSocket embed native NSView, (b) wry wrapping WKWebView in gtk::Widget, or (c) separate native window for raw mode (worse UX). Document in ADR 0002 with fallback decision BEFORE production code. Fallbacks: separate window (ships, worse) or drop raw mode to 1.1 (scope cut).

constraints: Webview exists ONLY in raw-mode tabs (invariant #10). Never introduce webviews elsewhere; app shell is GTK4 native.

SSRF at HTTP layer (invariant #8): EVERY outbound http request (incl. redirect hops) through FetchPolicy::check_url - resolved-IP check defeats DNS rebinding. reqwest 0.13: no per-request redirect, use Client-level Policy::custom that calls check_url per hop + surface 3xx as final_url for Dispatcher re-vet (Phase 2 pattern).
PGP verify BEFORE extraction (invariant #6): raw bytes verified before legible HTML extraction/markdown parse/rendering. Enforced by tracing-hook order test.
Incognito forces Reader mode (no raw mode in incognito); incognito enforced at FetchContext, not UI.
Ad-filter never applied in incognito; makelist rules bundled at build time (never runtime download).
Explicit user confirmation for downloads / new-window / irreversible side effects (invariant #7) - never auto-accept.
tokio exclusively, thiserror for libs, anyhow for app, no unwrap() in non-test code.
Every external crate must pass docs/references/library-lookup-protocol.md before being added (legible, scraper, comrak, adblock, objc2-web-kit, webkit6, etc.).
macOS-first (1.0 target); Linux/Windows webview conditional builds (#[cfg(target_os=...)]) but macOS path must be proven via SPIKE first.
Coverage >=65% overall (phase 3 exit), >=80% per new crate (ADR 0005).
handoff_to_phase_3: h1: register prefix-less http/https default adapter (p3-t7)
h2: promote spike_textview to production + link TextTag activate -> navigator (p3-t6)
h3: per-protocol fixture widget-tree render tests (p3-t6)
h4: GtkTextTag CSS for promoted render path (p3-t6)

phase3_handoff.spike_textview: crates/hypernext-ui spike_textview (GtkTextView + child anchors) from Phase 2 text-selection spike - promotes to production in p3-t6
phase3_handoff.reqwest_013_note: No per-request redirect in reqwest 0.13; no-follow is Client-level. WebFinger already uses Client::builder().redirect(Policy::none()) + surfaces 3xx final_url (Phase 2 pattern to reuse).

plan_summary: 7 tasks / 4 waves. Wave 1: p3-t1 hypernext-http core (SSRF/size/redirects). Wave 2: p3-t2 readability extract + p3-t3 adblock. Wave 3: p3-t4 raw webview SPIKE (highest risk) + p3-t5 web mode toggle. Wave 4: p3-t6 reader render pipeline (h2/h3/h4) + p3-t7 HTTP adapter (h1). HIGH complexity due to macOS webview SPIKE + security boundaries.
